page_title: CLE 1-1 STR | Clermont v Strasbourg 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Habib Keita (Clermont) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bilal Boutobba.
90+6' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
90+6' Clermont are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

90' The free kick is delivered by Johan Gastien (Clermont) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
89' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Clermont are awarded the free kick.
87' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
86' Substitution. Junior Mwanga is replaced by Steven Baseya (Strasbourg).
86' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Clermont players look gutted.
85' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Benoit Millot wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
85' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) has a goal ruled out for offside!

83' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benoit Millot stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Clermont, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
81' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
80' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Great save! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Matz Sels.
78' Here is a change. Frederic Guilbert is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) replaces Moise Sahi Dion.
74' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
72' Johan Gastien (Clermont) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
72' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Muhammed Cham (Clermont) replacing Elbasan Rashani.
72' Substitution. Jim Allevinah (Clermont) replaces Mehdi Zeffane.
70' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

70' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Massamba N'Diaye, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
70' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' 8:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 5:1.
63' Johan Gastien (Clermont) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
62' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
61' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Grejohn Kyei.
60' The game is interrupted now, Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) replaces Angelo.
59' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
59' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
57' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

52' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Shamar Nicholson (Clermont). Bilal Boutobba plays a through ball and finds Shamar Nicholson (Clermont), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalpeeper and fire a close-range shot into the top right corner. It's now 1:1.
50' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Matz Sels stops the ball from going inside the left post.
49' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Johan Gastien (Clermont) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

45+1' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Clermont force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Johan Gastien (Clermont) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
40' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
37' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Neto Borges (Clermont) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

34' 0 - 1 Goal Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg)! Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) was put through by Ibrahima Sissoko and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
34' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will deliver the corner kick.

33' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
31' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
29' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
28' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Massamba N'Diaye, who smothers the ball.
25' Neto Borges (Clermont) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matz Sels intercepts the ball.
25' Benoit Millot blows his whistle. Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Clermont.
24' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
20' Johan Gastien (Clermont) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
18' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Matz Sels easily deals with the threat.
17' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
15' What a chance! The ball is inside the box and Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) takes a first-time shot on goal, but his volley goes narrowly wide of the left post.
14' Johan Gastien (Clermont) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box. Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.

13' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Clermont.
11' The Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Benoit Millot rules it out for a foul.
10' Johan Gastien (Clermont) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' The ball is cleared after Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Clermont are awarded a corner kick.
8' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Massamba N'Diaye comes off his line to gather the ball.

6' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Strasbourg have been awarded a free kick.
4' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) tries to find Dilane Bakwa, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
2' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) sends a long ball in, but Massamba N'Diaye comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Clermont will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot will officiate today.
